name: Silence Forest
detailed_description:
Silent Forest is a card-based roguelike game that marries simple controls with deep, varied gameplay. Its clean hand-drawn visuals and perfectly matched sound effects draw players into a vibrant fantasy world where storybook charm conceals genuine people and tales.

Venturing into the wilderness is the shared destiny of every saturated civilization. In the new millennium, when booming populations outgrew urban space, the government of Min City issued a provocative call: “Advance into the forest; our tomorrow lies within.” After the latest global crisis was averted, late-developing nations entered a golden era. One frontier town of fewer than ten thousand residents, empowered by the newly laid railway, swelled into a million-strong megacity within just three decades. Yet overcrowded streets, polluted rivers, and the bones of the homeless soon revealed the limits of that progress; expansion outward seemed the only path forward.

Into this uncertain frontier steps Ann, an unmistakable rookie whom seasoned forest dwellers view as a lamb to the slaughter. For her, the journey is a life-or-death contest with the unknown: she must defeat jungles brimming with beasts and hazards to grow stronger, and she must choose wisely in sudden events to avoid hidden traps.

Ann is a semi-professional mage who attacks primarily with magic. She plays cards to amass elemental points and then spends those points to cast spells, but her limited stamina restricts how often she can do so. Clever card combinations allow her not only to strike foes but also to heal herself, making recovery a core part of her toolkit.

Her main study is Primal Magic, a fundamental form whose structure can be reshaped by outside influence. A pristine droplet of Primal Magic may seem fragile, yet under manipulation a single drop can unleash a raging wave; when Ann acquires multiple copies of the same Primal Magic card, its effect upgrades accordingly.

Throughout each run, players collect cards and explore the charm of strategic synergies; they can fuse cards at a synthesis table for deeper deck-building tactics, dance across the board using obstacles to weave between hits and dodges, and experience events that reveal the complex relationships behind every character. Traveling between town and forest underscores the boundless possibilities within the rallying cry to venture into the wild, while casinos and inns offer a taste of human warmth, chill, and the whims of fate along the way.
